## Où j'en suis
On branch tom/dashboard-grid-v2, the dashboards_v2 grid is implemented behind the flag: drag/resize via react-grid-layout, per-user/dashboard server-side layout persistence with localStorage fallback, iOS 15 sizing through a ResizeObserver data-size hook, WidgetCard rename, and lint/typecheck/test/Storybook fixes. Draft PR kestrel-analytics/platform#418 is open; last commit d2286a0; v1 dashboards remain untouched and the work is waiting on UX review plus flags-admin configuration.

- [en-cours] Draft PR kestrel-analytics/platform#418 is open and not yet reviewed.
- [prochaine-étape] Get Priya's UX review on the Zest iPad/BrowserStack.
- [prochaine-étape] Enable dashboards_v2 only for Zest in flags admin before Tuesday 24th.
- [essai-raté] Container queries failed on iOS 15 Safari, which ignored them and left widgets small.
- [décision] Keep v1 dashboards until January and remove nothing now; flag only for Zest (source: t15).
